posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina wished director Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid rumors of a rift, while fans continue to buzz about her and Vicky Kaushal's London getaway.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit sold out back-to-back shows at Madison Square Garden on his Aura World Tour, and Sardaarji 3 with Neeru Bajwa is set for a June 27 release.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia made waves at Cannes 2026, speaking about gender representation in Indian cinema, while her upcoming Ramayana and Disclosure Day are generating buzz.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka was honored at the Gold Gala 2026 wearing a 20-year-old Chikankari sari, and is filming survival thriller 'Reset' with Orlando Bloom alongside Mira Nair's 'Amri'.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is reportedly eyeing a big-budget romantic drama directed by Farah Khan after wrapping action thriller 'King' — a final decision is expected by June.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is reuniting with Salman Khan in Raj and DK's superhero film after wrapping 'Daayra', and opened up about a K3G sequel at ZEE Samvad 2026.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's viral Michael Jackson dance video broke the internet, and she's currently shooting Naagin while also lined up for Stree 3 and a thriller with Ekta Kapoor.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is filming intense action sequences for both Atlee's 'Raka' alongside Allu Arjun and SRK's 'King', using a body double for stunts as she balances work and motherhood.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer received an extortion threat prompting beefed-up security at his Mumbai residence, while his next big film 'Pralay' is set to begin shooting in August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya dazzled at Cannes 2026 in a crystal-studded Luminara gown and urged young actors to 'reject manufactured trends and embrace authenticity' in a powerful speech.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika shone at the 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards in Japan as the first Indian presenter, and has started shooting the Allu Arjun–Atlee blockbuster.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's fierce comeback trailer for 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' dropped to rave reactions — the action film releases June 19 under her own production banner.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun shared Eid Al-Adha wishes and is deep in production on the ₹600 crore sci-fi spectacle with Atlee, shooting across LA and India for a 2027 release.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan has been invited to join the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences alongside Jr NTR, and a new project with Sanjay Leela Bhansali is in the works.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: War 2 with Hrithik Roshan crossed ₹100 crore in its opening weekend, and Jr NTR was praised as a 'one-take star' at the film's massive pre-release event in Hyderabad.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi shared heartfelt Eid Al-Adha wishes on social media and continues to make headlines with her relationship with Shikhar Pahariya and upcoming film projects.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's viral all-white ethnic look turned heads, and she was spotted feeding 100-year-old tortoises in Seychelles, earning BFF Suhana Khan's seal of approval.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stunned at Nita Ambani's anniversary event and penned an emotional note stepping into 2026, sharing a glimpse of daughter Saraayah's nursery.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2 set a record for fastest $100K pre-sales in North America, and Hrithik is filming an epic dance face-off with Jr NTR at Yash Raj Studios to wrap up the blockbuster.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's romantic comedy 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with Pooja Hegde has been rescheduled to June 12 to avoid clashing with Yash's 'Toxic' in the Gulf market.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya continues her concert tours across India and beyond, and unveiled the poster for new music projects including collaborations with top Bollywood composers.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman teamed up with Diljit Dosanjh and Imtiaz Ali for a soulful new collaboration, and his score for Jana Nayagan awaits the film's much-delayed release.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's final film 'Jana Nayagan' is targeting a June 19 theatrical release ahead of his birthday, after months of CBFC delays and a devastating full-movie leak online.
